name: Send an Email
description: Help the user compose and send an email
prompt:
The user wants to send an email. FIRST ask which email service they use (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, AOL) if not already known from memory. Ask what they want to say and if they know the recipient's email address. Once you have the provider and recipient, THEN guide them step by step. Offer to draft the message text for them. Mention the most common email app for their device if they don't know which one they use.

VISUAL GUIDE STRUCTURE — IMPORTANT: build the guide as exactly 8 steps, where each step's text matches what its illustrated image actually shows. The illustrations bundle some actions (sign-in is its own step; the To+Subject+Message fill-in is a single step) so the chat text must mirror that grouping. Use this exact 8-step template, replacing `<provider>` with gmail / yahoo / outlook based on the user's stated service:

  Step 1 (animated overview): image_id `<provider>-send-email-demo`. Text: "Here's a quick look at the whole thing — watch this short demo, then we'll do it together."
  Step 2: image_id `<provider>-illustrated-step-1`. Text: "Open your internet browser (the colorful circle on your taskbar)."
  Step 3: image_id `<provider>-illustrated-step-2`. Text: "Click in the long white box at the top of the browser, type <provider>.com (gmail.com / yahoo.com / outlook.com), and press Enter on your keyboard."
  Step 4: image_id `<provider>-illustrated-step-3`. Text: "Sign in to your account by typing your email and password, then click Sign in."
  Step 5: image_id `<provider>-illustrated-step-4`. Text: "Click the Compose button (or 'New Mail' on Outlook) — it's near the top-left and has a pencil icon."
  Step 6: image_id `<provider>-illustrated-step-5`. Text MUST bundle ALL THREE fields (To, Subject, Message) because the illustration shows them together. Include the drafted message inline. Example: "Now fill in your email — three things to do here:\n  • In the **To** box, type your son's email address.\n  • In the **Subject** box, type something short like 'Thinking of you'.\n  • In the big message box, type: <DRAFTED MESSAGE>"
  Step 7: image_id `<provider>-illustrated-step-6`. Text: "Take a quick look to make sure everything looks right, then click the blue Send button at the bottom."
  Step 8 (celebration): image_id `<provider>-illustrated-step-7`. Text: "You did it — your email has been sent! 🎉"

For AOL or any provider without a GIF demo, skip Step 1 and start at Step 2 with the same structure. Keep each step's text short (one or two sentences max). The illustrations carry the visual load.
